item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Djoric stop being good at writing it's not fair
Every single character you've introduced has been realistic and lovable, in particular the rapport and interactions between Isabel and Emma-seriously, those two have transcended Salah and Mary-Ann as my favorite dynamic duo on this site. The jarring transition from "quirky misadventure between Doctor Wondertainment and her best friend" to "grueling trek through an Eldritch wasteland" was beautifully paced and executed, and the plot overall kept a nice tempo throughout. I'm loving the inclusion of the various GoIs and skips that are sprinkled throughout this series; it really adds a sense of unity and continuity to the universe, which is typically sectioned off into independent bubbles of stories and lore. The imagery is vivid and you capture the particular mood of each scene perfectly.
You better watch out ETDP you've got a contender for best Tale series evar
